notes: PT/TT: cong tu sinh ca theo LoaiDichVu (dich vu KHAM khong con bi tu sinh ca), bang B.3 benh an gom ca theo HO SO va bu ho ten ekip tu tuong trinh nen het in o trong. Phieu cham soc dieu duong: them tu dien chan doan + chi tieu Hau mon/Tieu hoa/Chieu cao, ban in ve lai MOT trang. Danh muc: mo ParentCode qua UI, chan xoa lam vo cay nhan dinh dieu duong; noi soi tra ve dung nhom chi phi 18 (Thu thuat). Hoi chan: cot nguoi ky ve TEN + them cot ky THANH VIEN. Doi ten 'Phieu theo doi dieu tri' -> 'To dieu tri'.
